- [Usage and billing](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/usage-and-billing.md): This section covers how data retention works and how it's priced in LangSmith.

- [How to use Studio](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/use-studio.md): This page describes the core workflows you’ll use in Studio. It explains how to run your application, manage assistant configurations, and work with conversation threads.
- [Use the Context Hub](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/use-the-context-hub.md): The **Context Hub** gives your team version-controlled, environment-aware management of the instructions and tools your agents use in production.
- [Use threads](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/use-threads.md): This guide shows you how to create, view, and inspect _threads_.

- [Use webhooks](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/use-webhooks.md): Webhooks enable event-driven communication from your LangSmith application to external services.
- [User management](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/user-management.md): This page covers user management features in LangSmith, including access control, authentication, and automated user provisioning:
- [View traces](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/view-traces.md): From a tracing project, use the **Threads**, **Traces**, or **Runs** tabs to change what appears in the table. Click into any row to open the side panel.
- [View usage](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/view-usage.md): LangSmith provides several views into your [organization's](/langsmith/administration-overview) usage, depending on your [plan](/langsmith/pricing-plans) and [hosting…
- [How to run evaluations with Vitest/Jest](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/vitest-jest.md): LangSmith provides integrations with [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/) and [Jest](https://jestjs.io/) that allow JavaScript and TypeScript developers to define their…
- [Configure webhook notifications for rules](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/webhooks.md): When you add a webhook URL on an automation action, LangSmith makes a POST request to your webhook endpoint any time the rules you defined match any new runs or threads.
- [Workload isolation](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/workload-isolation.md): LangSmith uses a hierarchical structure to organize your work: [_organizations_](/langsmith/administration-overview#organizations),…
- [Write your prompt with AI](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/write-prompt-with-ai.md): The prompt canvas makes it easy to edit a prompt with the help of an LLM.
